questionText: In which year was the First Battle of Panipat fought?
explanation: The First Battle of Panipat was fought on 21 April 1526 between Babur and Ibrahim Lodi, marking the beginning of the Mughal Empire in India.

questionText: Who was the founder of the Maurya Dynasty in ancient India?
explanation: Chandragupta Maurya founded the Maurya Empire in 322 BCE with the guidance of his guru Chanakya (Kautilya).

questionText: The historic 'Dandi March' led by Mahatma Gandhi in 1930 was launched to protest against which unjust law?
explanation: Mahatma Gandhi began the historic Salt Satyagraha on March 12, 1930, walking from Sabarmati to Dandi to defy the British monopoly on salt production.

questionText: Which Mughal Emperor abolished the pilgrim tax and Jizya on non-Muslim subjects?
explanation: Emperor Akbar abolished the pilgrim tax in 1563 and the Jizya tax in 1564 as part of his policy of Sulh-i-kul (universal peace).

questionText: The Indus Valley site 'Lothal', famous for its ancient dockyard, is located in which modern state of India?
explanation: Lothal is situated near the Bhogava river in the Bhal region of modern Gujarat, and served as a prominent Harappan tidal dockyard and port city.

questionText: Who was the founder of the Maurya Empire in ancient India?
explanation: Chandragupta Maurya founded the Maurya Empire in 322 BCE with the guidance of Chanakya (Kautilya).

questionText: The Indus Valley site of Harappa was discovered in 1921 by which archaeologist?
explanation: Daya Ram Sahni excavated Harappa in 1921. Mohenjodaro was excavated in 1922 by R.D. Banerjee.

questionText: Which Mughal Emperor built the famous 'Buland Darwaza' at Fatehpur Sikri?
explanation: Akbar built the Buland Darwaza (Gate of Magnificence) in 1601 to commemorate his victory over Gujarat.

questionText: [Hist-9] In which year was the First Battle of Panipat fought?
explanation: The First Battle of Panipat was fought on 21 April 1526 between Babur and Ibrahim Lodi, establishing the Mughal Empire.

questionText: Who was the Governor-General of India during the Revolt of 1857?
explanation: Lord Canning was the Governor-General of India during the 1857 revolt and became the first Viceroy under the Government of India Act 1858.

questionText: In which session of the Indian National Congress was the resolution of 'Poorna Swaraj' (Complete Independence) adopted?
explanation: The Lahore Session of INC in December 1929, presided over by Jawaharlal Nehru, passed the historic Poorna Swaraj resolution.

questionText: Who founded the 'Arya Samaj' in 1875?
explanation: Swami Dayanand Saraswati founded the Arya Samaj in Bombay in 1875 with the motto 'Go back to the Vedas'.

questionText: The historic 'Dandi March' (Salt Satyagraha) was initiated by Mahatma Gandhi from Sabarmati Ashram in which year?
explanation: Mahatma Gandhi began the Dandi March on March 12, 1930 and broke the salt law at Dandi on April 6, 1930, launching the Civil Disobedience Movement.

questionText: Who was the founder of the Slave (Mamluk) Dynasty in Delhi Sultanate?
explanation: Qutb-ud-din Aibak founded the Mamluk/Slave dynasty in 1206 CE.

questionText: Who among the following was known as the 'Frontier Gandhi'?
explanation: Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan was known as the Frontier Gandhi (Badshah Khan) and founded the Khudai Khidmatgar movement.

questionText: Battle of Plassey was fought in which year?
explanation: Fought on June 23, 1757 between British East India Company (Robert Clive) and Siraj-ud-Daulah.

questionText: Battle of Buxar was fought in which year?
explanation: Fought on October 22, 1764, confirming British control over Bengal, Bihar, and Orissa.

questionText: Third Battle of Panipat was fought in which year?
explanation: Fought on January 14, 1761 between Ahmad Shah Durrani and the Marathas.

questionText: Second Battle of Panipat was fought in which year?
explanation: Fought on November 5, 1556 between Hemu and Akbar's forces led by Bairam Khan.

questionText: The Non-Cooperation Movement was launched by Mahatma Gandhi in which year?
explanation: Launched in 1920 after the Jallianwala Bagh massacre and Rowlatt Act.

questionText: The Quit India Movement was launched in which year?
explanation: Launched on August 8, 1942 at the Gowalia Tank Maidan in Bombay with the call 'Do or Die'.

questionText: The Partition of Bengal was announced by Lord Curzon in which year?
explanation: Announced in July 1905 and took effect on October 16, 1905, triggering the Swadeshi Movement.

questionText: The Jallianwala Bagh Massacre took place on 13th April of which year?
explanation: General Reginald Dyer ordered troops to fire on unarmed gathering on Baisakhi day in Amritsar in 1919.

questionText: The Gandhi-Irwin Pact was signed in which year?
explanation: Signed on March 5, 1931, leading to the suspension of the Civil Disobedience Movement.

questionText: The Indian National Congress was founded in which year?
explanation: Founded in December 1885 at Bombay by A.O. Hume, with W.C. Bonnerjee as its first President.
